_ruling: C1 extends to the rail. Ruled by Matt 2026-08-13, during the shelf reconciliation that made this repository's games.json the canonical shelf. Desk ruling C1 (site repo 161af34, 2026-08-12: 'the games wear their own colours, and the breaches go on the record') reverted the driving games' shelf hues to their identity colours and recorded the resulting sub-floor pairs rather than working around them, because at ~50 entries the sRGB regions clearing the floor against the whole shelf no longer include the games' own liveries - a metric that can only be satisfied by abandoning the thing it proxies has stopped measuring it. The same reasoning holds a fortiori on the rail. So S3 in verify_sports_rail.js accepts a sub-floor rail pair ONLY if it is declared here, and this file is a record, not an allow-list: every entry names its pair by href (stable identity - titles carry the ephemeral NEW marker), pins the exact hues it vouches for, and cites its evidence. S3 re-measures the distance and refuses the record if either hue has moved, so an entry cannot silently cover a later repaint, and an UNRECORDED sub-floor pair still fails - the S8 control proves both directions every run. RETIRED 2026-08-14, ruled by Matt. Both entries named /rallyvector3d/, and Rally left the Sports rail when its collection was dropped (Games 992883f, merged 57f6249, per the Apex-family-rail ruling). Neither pair can arise any more, so both records were inert - they excused nothing and documented a state that no longer exists. They are removed rather than left lying, because an inert entry in a record like this reads as a live exception. The history is not lost: the pairs, their measured deltas and the C1 reasoning are in tools/RECORD_rally_leaves_sports_rail.md and in reports/2026-08-12-two-driving-games-launch.md in the site repository. An EMPTY record is the strong state, not a gap: with nothing recorded, S3 refuses every sub-floor pair a change introduces, and it no longer has anywhere to hide one. S8's proof-that-it-can-fail no longer depends on this file having contents - it consumes tools/rail_hue_breach_fixture.json instead.
